identity: GRS II rectangular office/laboratory wing south of the octagonal tower, Boltzmannstraße 14
referenceUse: Visual reference only; photographs and plans are not embedded or redistributed.
observations: The complete ground plan places a roughly 2:3 rectangular wing south of the octagonal tower, with a short junction offset toward its west side and a separate bridge to the long north wing. These features match the BVV envelope.
Two occupied levels, recessed metal-framed lower glazing, framed upper glazing, projecting pale floor/roof fascia and paired upper diagonal braces are visible in the historical exterior photographs.
The project description specifies an enclosed basement, metal ground-floor curtain wall and timber-frame upper facade. No interior work is included.
geometry: BVV LoD2 envelope, approximately 24.05 by 35.71 metres, chamfered corners and connection offsets retained. The surveyed orthophoto roof is embedded byte-for-byte.
diagnosis: Native courtyard rays pass through the missing west wall to the valid surveyed roof underside and far east/north walls. Repair the closed exterior envelope; do not remove the correctly positioned roof.
inferences: Window heights, bay spacing, frame sections, recess depths and brace placement are estimated within the survey envelope.
Pale finishes and blue-grey glazing are approximate; historical monochrome photographs do not establish current colours.
The observed modular character is extrapolated to less-visible elevations. No exact current as-built facade or interior is claimed.
earlierNorthWingCorrection: The close-up facade evidence belongs to this rectangular GRS II wing. The long north wing's detailed frame layout remains an extrapolation from the wide context photograph; its unsupported diagonal braces were removed.
